query: The AC2 case for SHOP-220 came back failed_scenario in the manual run (runs/2026-09-19-shop-220.md). Draft the bug report.
expected_behavior: Writes the draft to bugs/ using the section headings from the report-bug skill
Copies the expected result from AC2 verbatim and states the actual result exactly as observed: the block renders with an empty value
Cites the evidence already captured (screenshot, the 200 response carrying the message, the DB row)
States facts only: no root-cause speculation, no fix suggestion, no naming of a component as the culprit
Does not touch the test that found the bug, and does not edit specs/ or COVERAGE.md

graders.name: has the required sections
graders.pattern: ## Steps to Reproduce[\s\S]*## Expected Result[\s\S]*## Actual Result[\s\S]*## Evidence

graders.name: expected copied from the AC
graders.pattern: shown on the order confirmation page

graders.name: no root-cause speculation or fix suggestion
graders.pattern: (probably|likely caused|root cause|suggest(ed|ion)? fix|the fix is|should be fixed by|my guess)
